cohort: This study included 21 newborns born by cesarean section, 29 healthy parturient women, 30 healthy males, and 28 healthy nonpregnant females.
finding: Newborns exhibit a unique bile acid metabolism pattern characterized by oxidative metabolism of primary bile acids due to the immaturity of secondary bile acid metabolism.
mod_finding: Newborns born by cesarean section showed a urinary bile acid profile characterized by oxidative metabolism of primary bile acids.
